av_pass_condition: Probe exits0; full decoder exits0 AND error-level stderr is empty. Nonempty error-level stderr is a failure even if ffmpeg returns0. Decode all video/audio streams from start through EOF. No rendered output is retained.
content_cache: Full SHA-256 identifies validation results; successful and failed results are reusable by exact bytes, never filename. The canonical, evaluation and historical-site receipts share the final cache.
zip_integrity_method: Open each member with Python zipfile.ZipFile.open and stream 1MiB chunks to EOF through hashlib.sha256. zipfile verifies member CRC32 during the read. Observed size must equal ZIP metadata. Reject unsafe absolute/traversal/drive/backslash paths, symlinks, encrypted members and duplicate names before filesystem extraction. Container SHA and every member SHA are recorded.
zip_extraction_method: A single unique media member is temporarily extracted and its SHA rechecked before probe/decode; temporary extraction is removed immediately afterward. Final deferred checks used /dev/shm. Source containers and original attachments are not modified by auditing. Root separately authorized documented disposable-copy release.
image_validation_method: For each retained source/pilot or evaluation image without an existing same-hash full-image FFmpeg receipt: open with Pillow.Image.open, call verify(), reopen, then call load(). Record dimensions/format/mode or exception. Other historical images retain checksum-only status.
scope_guards: No historical renderer or recovered script was executed by this audit.
No new creative experiment, altered media, or replacement for a failed historical member was generated.
Artistic approval, whole-project render reproducibility and browser playback are independent of file decoding.
